products.title: SomnoFlo® O2Care
products.summaryHtml: Blend air and O₂
products.summary: Blend air and O₂
products.sourceIntroHtml:
Recent research has suggested that pure oxygen can cause unintended off-target effects during veterinary anesthesia, but 21% oxygen isn’t always enough to prevent hypoxia. Custom gas blends are cumbersome and external gas mixers can be cumbersome, expensive, or difficult to use.

SomnoFlo® O2Care solves these problems by blending ambient air and 100% compressed oxygen to deliver the ideal anesthetic carrier gas composition for your animals. Now you can get the oxygen supplementation that they need, without any external gas mixers or custom gas blends!

SomnoFlo O2Care allows you to connect a pure oxygen source and easily adjust the carrier gas composition to 21%, 35%, 50%, 70%, or 100% oxygen. Perfect for long procedures where supplemental O2 is required, for recovery phases, emergencies, or anyone looking to refine their anesthetic protocols.

(SomnoFlo O2Care operates using an internal air pump with ambient air or with compressed gas. If your regulator exceeds 15psi, the SOMNO-7305 Preset Pressure Reducer is required to regulate the pressure)

products.title: RoVent® Jr.
products.summaryHtml: Automatic small animal ventilator
products.summary: Automatic small animal ventilator
products.sourceIntroHtml:
The RoVent® Jr. small animal ventilator is ideal for mice, rats and guinea pigs up to 1,250 grams. The ventilator is fully automatic, simply enter the animals weight and press run. You have the ability to control ventilation by either volume or pressure.

The RoVent Jr. provides a number of features that make it an ideal system for in-vivo COVID-19 research. The built-in touchscreen display provides information about your current ventilator settings. You have the ability to customize the display; many of the parameters can easily be displayed as numeric numbers or on a real-time graph. The real-time display screen has the capability to show numeric readings, waveforms, or both simultaneously.

products.sourceIntroHtml:
Brain matrices were developed to provide medical researchers with the ability to precisely prepare discrete regions in fresh or preserved tissue samples.

Acrylic brain matrices are offered as durable and economical devices to prepare your tissue samples. Acrylic matrices are not recommended for heat or cold transfer and will become brittle if cooled or frozen.

We have selected our matrices to section tissue slices to a thickness as small as approximately 1 mm, depending upon what matrix design you choose to use. Ordinary industrial razor blades are generally used to slice the brain and/or tissue material. We recommend that the cutting blade be wetted with saline to act as a lubricant before shearing the target tissue. Micron tissue punches are also available for removal of specific areas of the tissues.

The coronal RBMs have the additional feature of a mid-line sagittal cut to facilitate the splitting of the left and right hemispheres. Sections can be as fine as 1 mm.

  • Repeatable slices to 1 mm providing precise blocking prior to sectioning

products.sourceIntroHtml:
The HTP-1500 Heat Therapy Pump is designed to circulate warmed water through compatible recirculating warming pads used in laboratory animal procedures. It allows you to safely warm small animals during surgery and recovery and provides accurate, localized heat therapy for temperature-sensitive workflows. The bright, easy-to-read display delivers continuous real-time temperature readings, while the digital controller uses proprietary software to manage your prescribed set-point temperature to within 1.0°F.

Three temperature safety limits help guard against overheating, and the hi-limit switches can be tested without taking the unit apart. Pump connections are modified for compatibility with the TPZ-814EA warming pads, and an 8-foot hose with couplings is included. This product is available in a 110V configuration only and is available only in the continental United States.

• Continuous real-time temperature display
• Set-point temperature control within 1.0°F
• Three temperature safety limits to help guard against overheating
• 8 ft hose and couplings included
• Modified for compatibility with TPZ-814EA warming pads

products.sourceIntroHtml:
Sarstedt Microvette® 200 capillary blood collection tubes are designed for small-volume blood sampling in mice and rats in laboratory research settings. The 200 µL format is well suited for rodent blood collection workflows where sample volume is limited and reliable handling is important. The preassembled end-to-end capillary supports controlled collection to the capillary technique and allows use of either the special rim or gravity-flow principle without difficulty.

These Microvette 200 tubes are a practical fit for preclinical, academic, and biomedical research labs performing routine mouse and rat blood collection, and are available in Potassium EDTA, Lithium Heparin, and Serum and Clotting Activator options. Due to the inherent design, capillary tubes are not sterilized.

• 200 µL capillary blood collection format
• Preassembled end-to-end capillary for controlled collection
• Supports special rim or gravity-flow collection technique
• Designed for mouse and rat blood collection
• Available in Potassium EDTA, Lithium Heparin, and Serum and Clotting Activator options

Microvette is a registered trademark of Sarstedt.

products.title: PRISM™ BIO-BOX In Vivo Imaging System
products.summaryHtml: Affordable bioluminescence and fluorescence imaging system for up to 5 mice. Research-grade sensitivity using a modern Sony sensor at a fraction of typical BLI system cost.
products.summary: Affordable bioluminescence and fluorescence imaging system for up to 5 mice. Research-grade sensitivity using a modern Sony sensor at a fraction of typical BLI system cost.
products.sourceIntroHtml:
The PRISM™ BIO-BOX is an affordable bioluminescence imaging (BLI) system designed for small animal in vivo imaging of up to 5 mice simultaneously. Built around a high-sensitivity Sony sensor, the BIO-BOX delivers research-grade BLI performance at a fraction of the cost of traditional BLI platforms. The system also includes fluorescence imaging capability via manually installed filters, making it a versatile and cost-effective solution for preclinical researchers.

The PRISM™ BIO-BOX also offers built-in anesthesia with Kent Scientific’s SomnoFlo system requiring no oxygen tank, concentrator, or gas line.

Currently available for sale in the US

Contact MediLumine for installation and training.

products.summaryHtml: High-sensitivity bioluminescence and fluorescence imaging platform with EMCCD photon-counting, real-time imaging, and optional 3D trans-illumination.
products.summary: High-sensitivity bioluminescence and fluorescence imaging platform with EMCCD photon-counting, real-time imaging, and optional 3D trans-illumination.
products.sourceIntroHtml:
The PRISM™ In Vivo Imaging System is a high-performance preclinical imaging platform combining EMCCD photon-counting technology with real-time fluorescence imaging. Designed for researchers who demand the highest sensitivity for bioluminescence and fluorescence studies, the PRISM supports visible and NIR-I wavelengths and includes an optional 3D trans-illumination module for depth localization. The system integrates seamlessly with MediLumine’s SomnoFlo®-compatible anesthesia workflow for streamlined multi-animal studies.

Currently available for sale in the US

Ships via freight on pallet. Contact MediLumine for installation and training.

products.title: PRISM™ SWIR In Vivo Imaging System
products.summaryHtml: Whole-animal SWIR (NIR-II) imaging system with real-time multi-color imaging, automated laser and exposure control, and deeper tissue penetration than NIR-I.
products.summary: Whole-animal SWIR (NIR-II) imaging system with real-time multi-color imaging, automated laser and exposure control, and deeper tissue penetration than NIR-I.
products.sourceIntroHtml:
The PRISM™ SWIR In Vivo Imaging System is MediLumine’s most advanced preclinical imaging platform, purpose-built for shortwave infrared (SWIR / NIR-II) whole-animal imaging. The system delivers real-time multi-color SWIR imaging with automated laser and exposure control, providing superior tissue penetration depth compared to conventional NIR-I systems. Ideal for researchers working with SWIR fluorophores or requiring deep-tissue signal detection in small animal models. Compatible with MediLumine’s SomnoFlo®-integrated anesthesia workflow.
